subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Should Microsoft Teams Graph media fallback for non-personal messages become automatic when no media is extracted, or stay default-off behind a new `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` option for the group-chat variant?
rationale: Current main avoids noisy Graph calls by requiring extracted attachment IDs, but Teams can omit those IDs for real uploaded files; the default affects existing deployments through Graph call volume, permission expectations, diagnostics, and message-delivery behavior.

options.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
options.body: Adopt the config-gated group-chat recovery while landing the channel AAD group id and reply URL fixes separately or in the same coordinated repair.

options.title: Automatic fallback
options.body: Relax the gate for non-personal HTML activities with no media so attachments work without new config, accepting extra Graph reads and possible mention-only noise.

options.title: Single combined repair
options.body: Ask one PR to cover channel team IDs, thread-reply URL shape, group-chat fallback, docs, and tests before any part lands.

recommendation.title: Default-off opt-in fallback
recommendation.body: Adopt the config-gated group-chat recovery while landing the channel AAD group id and reply URL fixes separately or in the same coordinated repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent ownership signal across the affected Teams plugin files and the remaining question is a product/config default tradeoff.
